title: Qubrid AI Inference Entities
description: Schema definitions for Qubrid AI Inference API request and response payloads, including chat completions, model listings, and embeddings.

ChatCompletionRequest.title: Chat Completion Request
ChatCompletionRequest.description: A request to generate a chat completion using an open-source model on the Qubrid AI platform.

model.description: The identifier of the model to use for generating the chat completion, such as deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-70B or Qwen/Qwen3.5-27B.

messages.description: A list of messages comprising the conversation so far.

temperature.description: Sampling temperature between 0 and 2 controlling output randomness.

top_p.description: Nucleus sampling parameter controlling token probability mass considered.

n.description: Number of chat completion choices to generate.

max_tokens.description: Maximum number of tokens to generate in the completion.

stream.description: Whether to stream partial message deltas as server-sent events.

stop.description: Up to 4 sequences where the API will stop generating further tokens.

presence_penalty.description: Penalty for new tokens based on presence in text so far.

frequency_penalty.description: Penalty for new tokens based on frequency in text so far.

ChatMessage.title: Chat Message
ChatMessage.description: A single message in a chat conversation with a role and content.

role.description: The role of the message author.

content.description: The content of the message, either a text string or an array of multimodal content parts.

ContentPart.title: Content Part
ContentPart.description: A content part for multimodal messages supporting text and image inputs.

text.description: The text content when type is text.

image_url.description: The image URL object when type is image_url.

ChatCompletionResponse.title: Chat Completion Response
ChatCompletionResponse.description: The response from a chat completion request containing generated message choices and usage statistics.

id.description: A unique identifier for the chat completion.

created.description: Unix timestamp in seconds of when the completion was created.

model.description: The model used for the chat completion.

choices.description: A list of chat completion choices.

ChatCompletionChoice.title: Chat Completion Choice
ChatCompletionChoice.description: A single generated completion choice with message content and finish reason.

index.description: The index of the choice in the list.

finish_reason.description: The reason the model stopped generating tokens.

Usage.title: Token Usage
Usage.description: Token usage statistics for an API request.

prompt_tokens.description: Number of tokens in the prompt.

completion_tokens.description: Number of tokens in the generated completion.

total_tokens.description: Total tokens used in the request.

Model.title: Model
Model.description: An AI model available for inference on the Qubrid AI platform.

id.description: The unique identifier of the model.

created.description: Unix timestamp of when the model was registered.

owned_by.description: The organization that owns or published the model.
